Sandbox_SkillObelisk_RecoverSkills_toolt: Restore the perk levels and XP the character had at death. The amount restored is scaled by Skill Recovery (%%).
Sandbox_SkillObelisk_RecoverRecipes_tool: Re-grant every recipe the character had learned. Most recipes are taught by skill magazines.
Sandbox_SkillObelisk_RecoverSkillMagazin: Mark skill magazines the character had already read as read.
Sandbox_SkillObelisk_RecoverReadPrintMed: Mark newspapers and print magazines the character had already read as read.
Sandbox_SkillObelisk_RecoverWatchedMedia: Mark VHS tapes and CDs the character had watched as watched, so they cannot be re-consumed for skill XP or moodles.
Sandbox_SkillObelisk_RecoverLearnedSongs: Lifestyles mod only — restore the instrument songs the character had learned. No effect if Lifestyles is not installed.
Sandbox_SkillObelisk_RecoverAmbitions_to: Lifestyles mod only — restore in-progress and completed ambitions. Numeric goal progress is scaled by Skill Recovery (%%). No effect if Lifestyles is not installed.
Sandbox_SkillObelisk_RecoverHiddenSkills: Lifestyles mod only — restore the hidden skills (Yoga, Inventing, Ping Pong) the character had at death. Levels restore in full; XP within the current level is scaled by Skill Recovery (%%). No effect if Lifestyles is not installed.
Sandbox_SkillObelisk_RecoverInventions_t: Lifestyles mod only — restore the inventions and toys the character had researched, with their improvement levels. Not scaled by Skill Recovery (%%): an invention is either known or not. No effect if Lifestyles is not installed.
Sandbox_SkillObelisk_SkillRecoveryPercen: Percentage (0-100) of perk XP, Lifestyles ambition progress, and Lifestyles hidden-skill XP to restore. 100 = full restore, 0 = nothing restored. Ignored for any slice whose Recover toggle is off.
Sandbox_SkillObelisk_CurseOnSledgehammer: A player who tries to sledgehammer an obelisk is struck dead by its curse. The obelisk survives either way; admins deleting via the brush tool are never cursed. When off, the attempt is simply blocked.
Sandbox_SkillObelisk_ShowDeathReminder_t: Pop up a reminder on death that skills can be recovered at an obelisk. The reminder is already hidden when Recover Skills is off or Skill Recovery (%%) is 0.
Sandbox_SkillObelisk_BlessingDurationHou: In-game hours an Obelisk Blessing lasts after a player receives it at a Blessing-type obelisk. Receiving it again restarts the timer.
Sandbox_SkillObelisk_BlessingXpBonusPerc: Extra XP a blessed player earns in every skill, as a percentage on top of the normal XP after the sandbox XP multipliers. 50 = 1.5x XP, 100 = 2x XP, 300 = 4x XP. Also boosts Lifestyles Yoga and Meditation XP.
Sandbox_SkillObelisk_MapShowGeneralObeli: Show general obelisks (type "None", not bound to a skill) as dots on the world map.
Sandbox_SkillObelisk_MapShowSkillObelisk: Show obelisks bound to a single skill as dots on the world map.
Sandbox_SkillObelisk_MapShowBlessingObel: Show Obelisk Blessing obelisks as dots on the world map.
Sandbox_SkillObelisk_ProximityAlertDista: When a player from outside your faction and safehouses is within this many tiles of a placed obelisk, the obelisk's glow pulses and a heartbeat plays at the stone for everyone who can see it. Staff (observer and above) never trigger it. 0 turns the alert off.
